title: Pure Yang Zing
summary: Yang Zing cards only, with staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Yang Zing are the nine sons of the dragon: Wyrms of every Attribute that summon another Yang Zing from the Deck when destroyed. Most of them can also Synchro Summon on the opponent's turn using only Yang Zing monsters. Jiaotu, Darkness of the Yang Zing sends two Yang Zing cards from your hand to the GY to summon a 0-ATK and a 0-DEF Yang Zing from the Deck. Chiwen, Light of the Yang Zing is the Tuner that comes back whenever a Yang Zing is destroyed. Each Yang Zing Synchro material passes on a bonus to the Synchro. Denglong, First of the Yang Zing, the newest card (2016), searches any Yang Zing card when summoned and calls another when it leaves. Yazi destroys one of yours and one of theirs, which sets off another float. Nine Pillars of Yang Zing negates anything by destroying your own Yang Zing. Yang Zing Creation locks the Extra Deck to Synchros.
